name: Craftsman's Writ: Iridescent Hammer
summary: A faded writ requests an Iridescent Hammer and gives details for delivery and payment. Its transferable mark lets the holder complete the exchange.

sections.title: The Writ
sections.body: The customer requests one Iridescent Hammer. You need the writ with you to complete the transaction at the marked location.

faq.answer: The customer requests one Iridescent Hammer.
The writ gives delivery details, and the location is marked on your map.

faq.q: Does the writ need to be with me?
faq.answer: Yes. You must have the writ in your possession to complete the transaction.

faq.q: Can someone else use the writ?
faq.answer: Yes. The writ is marked as transferable.

faq.q: Does the writ say how payment works?
faq.answer: The writ includes information about payment.

attribution: In-game quest text: Craftsman's Writ: Iridescent Hammer
